question: How many Indian states shares its border with Bangladesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Five.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian states that share borders with Bangladesh are Assam, West Bengal, Mizoram, Meghalaya, and Tripura.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bc445531ca1b857fd2e1cd0f5266c691289c5a5ac75bbdc98062ac161f4f38b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• India shares borders with **Bangladesh, China, Pakistan, Nepal, Myanmar, Bhutan, and Afghanistan.**
 
• The longest border is shared by **Bangladesh which is 4096.70 Km (2,545 miles). **
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, and Mizoram share**** the border with Myanmar.**
 
• **Assam shares the international border with Bhutan and Bangladesh.**
